speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you tell me more about the onset of the swelling and pain in your right ring finger, and have you experienced any recent trauma or bites in that area?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text: That mechanism of injury strongly suggests a tendon or ligament injury. Can you actively extend the tip of your right ring finger straight up when I ask you to?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text: Based on your inability to flex the fingertip and the extended resting position, this is highly suggestive of a jersey finger injury. Can you confirm if you feel a palpable gap or defect at the base of your fingernail?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant medical history. Social history: Student and active in sports, particularly football. Non-smoker and drinks alcohol socially.

speaker: Doctor
text: The mechanism of injury and your specific symptoms point towards a flexor tendon avulsion, commonly known as a jersey finger. I need to visualize the extent of the tendon retraction to confirm the diagnosis and plan treatment. REQUEST TEST: X-Ray_Ring_Finger
